race.comment: HANEY (5) is going well this time in work, including a last start win over 1000m at Scone to bring up two wins from four runs in the campaign. Jordie Thompson who has two wins when partnering stays on. Expecting a bold showing. The well-related OLUFSEN (3) (full to G1 winner Ozzmosis) improved sharply on his sixth two starts back at Coffs Harbour with a win as public elect over 1220m at Barraba nine days ago, getting home by 2.5 lengths. It doesn't get any easier but on his best form he is one of the chief contenders. COSMOLICIOUS (6) was in the money first-up then met with strong support last time but could only manage sixth over 1200m at this track. Can bounce back to her best form. IRISH JIG (1) has been in the market at his last couple of runs but failed to threaten, the latest effort a modest fifth at Gunnedah over 1250m. Can improve and is worth including in calculations.
